limits: Instagram post captions, likes, comments and views were not obtained.
No private reach, saves, shares, impressions, CTR, retention or subscriber attribution data was obtained.
Videos were classified from public titles and descriptions, not audiovisual inspection.
Different publication dates and a four-video sample prevent causal performance conclusions.
